item.title: Tensions flare near Strait of Hormuz as a ship is seized and another is sunk
item.description: Tensions are escalating again near the Strait of Hormuz after a ship anchored off the United Arab Emirates was seized and taken toward Iran and another was attacked and sank near the coast of Oman.

item.title: Pope decries rise of AI-directed warfare, saying it leads to a spiral of annihilation
item.description: Pope Leo XIV denounced how investments in artificial intelligence and high-tech weaponry were leading the world into a "spiral of annihilation," as he called for peace in the Middle East and Ukraine.

item.title: China and U.S. agree Hormuz shouldn’t be ‘militarized,’ Marco Rubio says
item.description: President Donald Trump discussed the Iran war and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz during a summit with President Xi Jinping, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told NBC News in an interview Thursday.

item.title: Trump praises Xi, says ‘wonderful things’ done during China summit
item.description: President Trump thanked President Xi during remarks on the second day of the U.S.-China summit. He said a lot of problems were settled during talks and indicated that the two leaders share similar feelings about wanting the war with Iran to end.

item.title: Death toll in attack on Kyiv apartment building now stands at 24
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that a Russian missile attack on a Kyiv apartment building the previous day killed 24 people, including three children.

item.title: Which Trump cabinet member has a new reality show? The quiz knows
item.description: This week, in Warshington, D.C., the Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh as the next chair of the Federal Reserve and we wrote a quiz question about his name. Enjoy that, and the other nine, too.

item.title: The 10 best songs competing at (a very contentious) Eurovision
item.description: Glitter, vocal gymnastics, on-stage flames — the show goes on on the Eurovision stage in Vienna, even though five countries are boycotting this year's contest due to Israel's participation.
